highlights_headline: Servicing release backporting Apple 26.0 TFM support and fixing WinUI Projection DLL loading.

bullets.detail: Backports the unversioned Apple app TFM support and 26.0 library targeting from later branches so apps on this line can target the newer Apple SDKs.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9
bullets.detail: Fixes a packaging issue that left the WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9 consumers, causing load failures at startup.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support
